create_lru_cache: create an LRUCache with a specified maximum size for storing key-value pairs
test_lru_cache_set_get: test the LRUCache set and get methods for storing and retrieving cached values
test_lru_cache_eviction: test the LRUCache eviction behavior when the cache exceeds its maximum size
test_lru_cache_info: test the LRUCache info method to retrieve hits, misses, size, max_size, usage, and hit_rate
test_lru_cache_make: test the LRUCache make method to retrieve or lazily compute and cache values
